findings.expected: A malformed response shows an error such as 'Could not load the journal.'
findings.actual: The page reports '14 entries' and lists 14 cards whose plant name, date and text are blank or '–', with no error

findings.title: Journal search shows a bad response as 'No entries match'
findings.expected: A response that is not a list is shown as an error
findings.actual: The page shows '0 entries match' and 'No entries match' for a search ('canes') that has a real match

findings.title: Hung journal search stays on 'Loading entries…' and keeps showing the old results
findings.expected: After a while the page shows an error or a timeout and offers a retry
findings.actual: After 20 s the page still shows 'Loading entries…', with the unfiltered list (including entries that don't match 'canes') under the search, and no error
